policy_text: PROPOSED ONLY. Standard Commander and Constructed2HG bans remain. No experimental unbans. Register BOTH decks and controller/zone-specific known win/lock lines before play. Reject repeatable unbounded resource/win/extra-combat engines, repeated extra turns or repeated control of opposing turns, and intentional mass land denial/participation locks from the submitted permitted-lines list; exact boundaries need organizer approval. Reject deliberately reliable pre-seventh-shared-turn deterministic wins, including combat loops, through construction review; merely waiting is not compliance. This is NOT temporary cannot-win/cannot-lose protection and does not alter Pact/Final Fortune/Ad Nauseam. No combo point surcharges. Ordinary finite synergies, interaction and team support remain allowed.
